predictions.prediction_text: I don’t expect vol this week; volatility will rise starting next week Tuesday/Wednesday causing a grind up in spot.
predictions.expected_result: Implied volatility remains low this week then increases on the specified days, accompanied by an upward grind in the SPX spot price

predictions.prediction_text: My risk target remains August as the pivot to determine whether this is a bear market or stagnation.
predictions.expected_result: By August the market regime will clarify: either showing sustained downside consistent with a bear market or stagnation with lateral price action

predictions.prediction_text: I expect a shift into a long vanna regime where ‘vol down’ creates supportive flows and spot upward grind will be stabilized through mechanical vol selling.
predictions.expected_result: A period where falling volatility coincides with sustained upward drift in SPX and option market flows are net vol-selling that mechanically support higher spot levels

predictions.prediction_text: The tariff deadline will turn vol up again, prompting me to scale into cheap 22/5-delta call spreads into August exposure.
predictions.expected_result: Implied volatility increases around the tariff deadline, making call spreads bought at low vols more valuable and producing gains for long call-spread positions into August

predictions.prediction_text: If July 9 passes with no further tariff delay, the market is very likely topped.
predictions.condition: July 9 passes with no further tariff delay
predictions.expected_result: SPX will exhibit a local top and fail to make higher sustained highs following July 9, leading to subsequent pullback or consolidation

predictions.prediction_text: If renewed tariff concerns spike, existing vol-selling/short-vol positions will be squeezed out leading to vol spikes (dampened by vol-of-vol supply).
predictions.expected_result: Short-vol/vol-selling positions are forced to cover, producing sharp increases in implied volatility and transient spikes in SPX option prices, though spikes may be moderated by available vol-of-vol supply

predictions.prediction_text: Odds favor chop intraday with potential for one nice reversion trade opportunity to play out.
predictions.expected_result: Intraday price action will be range-bound and choppy, offering quick mean-reversion opportunities around identified support/resistance/reversion bands

predictions.prediction_text: Reversion trades: if price hits resistance/reversion threshold, expect quick downside to trade with puts; if price hits support/lower reversion bands, expect quick upside to trade with calls.
predictions.condition: price reaching resistance/reversion threshold or support/lower reversion bands intraday
predictions.expected_result: Short-duration directional scalps from resistance will produce quick down moves captured by puts, and from support produce quick up moves captured by calls, with typical targets reached within a short time horizon (catch-and-run)
